name_note: Earlier vaginal studies use the 16S clone names Megasphaera type 1 and type 2 (phylotypes MP1 and MP2); the species description reports 99.9 percent 16S identity between those clones and the type strains of Megasphaera lornae and Megasphaera hutchinsoni.

sentences.text: Those clone types are described as members of the human vaginal microbiota associated with bacterial vaginosis, preterm birth and HIV acquisition.
The genital tract isolates were reported to be asaccharolytic, to metabolise organic acids and amino acids, and to produce butyrate, isobutyrate and isovalerate.
In 3870 women, a study reported that Megasphaera phylotype 1 had a stronger positive association with bacterial vaginosis, while phylotype 2 was positively associated with trichomoniasis.
